stem: Which of the following has the square planar structure?
solution: $\text{XeF}_4$ has square planar structure, while $\text{NH}_4^+$, $\text{BF}_4^-$ and $\text{CCl}_4$ have tetrahedral structure.

stem: A binary liquid solution is prepared by mixing $n$-heptane and ethanol. Which one of the following statements is correct regarding the behaviour of the solution?
options: The solution is non-ideal, showing - ve deviation from Raoult's Law.
The solution is non-ideal, showing + ve deviation from Raoult's Law.
n-Heptane shows + ve deviation while ethanol shows - ve deviation from Raoult's Law.
The solution formed is an ideal solution.
solution: For this solution, intermolecular interactions between $n$-heptane and ethanol are weaker than $n$-heptane–$n$-heptane and ethanol–ethanol interactions. Hence, the solution of $n$-heptane and ethanol is non-ideal and shows positive deviation from Raoult's law.

stem: The order of reactivity of the given haloalkanes towards nucleophile is:
solution: For a given alkyl group, the order of reactivity is $\text{R–I} > \text{R–Br} > \text{R–Cl} > \text{R–F}$ (increasing bond energy, decreasing halogen reactivity). This order depends on the carbon-halogen bond energy; the carbon-fluorine bond energy is maximum and thus fluorides are least reactive while carbon-iodine bond energy is minimum hence iodides are most reactive.

What type of crystal defect is indicated in the diagram below?

$\text{Na}^+\text{Cl}^-\text{Na}^+\text{Cl}^-\text{Na}^+\text{Cl}^-$
$\text{Cl}^-\square\text{Cl}^-\text{Na}^+\square\text{Na}^+$
$\text{Na}^+\text{Cl}^-\square\text{Cl}^-\text{Na}^+\text{Cl}^-$
$\text{Cl}^-\text{Na}^+\text{Cl}^-\text{Na}^+\square\text{Na}^+$
solution: As equal number of $\text{Na}^+$ and $\text{Cl}^-$ ions are missing from their lattice sites, it is Schottky defect.
